scope: Current CAMISIM source and publisher documentation, not proof of exact historical oral generator commit
findings: Source-base (not read-consensus) GSA via mpileup: split when source record or covered position is discontinuous
Pooled coverage joins covered positions across admitted libraries; a boundary need not be an assembler branch
Reads simulated separately from provided input sequences cannot supply a true molecule across unrelated source records
With 150 bp reads and median insert 268-269, overlapping mates usually cover a whole fragment continuously; pooled zero-coverage cuts have little chance of a short true bridge
This explains limited relevance of Oral GSA to physical-link performance, without proving every mapping or discordant endpoint cause
